text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, I accompany Nishino Flower
in waiting
for one of her flowers to
bloom. Apparently, it
only blooms at
night.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm... It should bloom any moment now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I usually go to bed at this time, so I'm a
bit
sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I'm going to do my best to stay up
tonight! I
want to be here when this
flower blooms!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but please don't push yourself,
okay? I was
the one who made you come
out here with me,
after all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower and I continue to chat
while
waiting for the flower to bloom...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?! I-I wasn't asleep, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There's no telling when the flower will
bloom, so I
have to stay alert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower fights valiantly against
her
drowsiness, but as time passes, the
flower bud
remains stubbornly shut...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the flower is still tightly
closed
when the sun rises...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-it's morning already?! Sorry, I didn't
mean to fall
asleep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Did the flower—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, it's okay. I knew these flowers don't
bloom
very often. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I had a great time waiting here with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If, um... we ever have the chance, will
you watch
the flower with me again?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though the flower didn't bloom, my
bond
with Nishino Flower feels a little
stronger than
before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Here's to another night of flower
watching!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want you to catch a chill, so I
brought
some hot tea with me. Here you
go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower and I drink tea and chat
while
waiting for the flower to bloom...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the flower is still tightly
closed
when the sun rises...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm sure it'll bloom next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though the flower didn't bloom, my
bond
with Nishino Flower feels a little
stronger than
before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm not overdoing it! Just look at how
full of
energy I—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: B-but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll take a short nap.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but make sure you don't overdo it
either,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to take turns napping and
coming
back out to check on the
flower...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Nishino Flower and I both sleep
straight
through to the next morning.
When we wake up,
we both rush to the
flower in a panic to see...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haha... Of course it bloomed last night.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it's okay! You don't need to
apologize! I
mean, I fell asleep too, so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. It's funny, though, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe we both slept straight
through it
blooming.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I guess it does. ♪
